reason: My lunch special changes every day and right now the website is always wrong, so sending a voice note I'm already used to and tapping once is exactly how I'd want to do it. 25 a month is less than one slow lunch service, so I'll try it for a month and cancel if it messes up.
objection: That the AI reads my chalkboard photo or a rushed voice note in a noisy kitchen wrong and puts the wrong price up, and I tap confirm without looking properly because I'm in the middle of service.
would_change_my_mind: If in the first week it gets prices wrong more than once or twice, or the preview is too fiddly to check on my phone during service, I cancel.
